channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: LMC Landscape Partners acquires Shinto Landscaping
item.description: LMC, backed by Trivest Partners, is expanding its footprint in Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties through this acquisition.

item.title: Kubota Engine America extends standard warranty
item.description: This move increases coverage from two years or 2,000 hours to three years or 3,000 hours.

item.title: NALP set for Field Trip to Timberline Landscaping in June
item.description: The program, which runs June 17-18, includes guided facility tours and discussions with Timberline’s leadership team in Colorado Springs.

item.title: LandCare adds Lytx+ with Geotab for fleet safety and telematics
item.description: LandCare's 1,200-plus vehicle fleet services 26 different states through more than 75 locations nationwide.

item.title: Virginia Green acquires Bio Turf
item.description: Bio Turf owner Rodney Lansdown will assist during the transition period to help maintain continuity.

item.title: John Deere debuts 1 Series Compact Utility Tractors
item.description: The updated lineup includes the 1E 23, 1M 25 and 1R 25 models.

item.title: Rotary Corporation names Brabandt as territory sales manager
item.description: Brabandt brings nine years of sales experience in the outdoor power equipment industry to his new role, which aims to support its dealer network across Indiana.

item.title: New Holland debuts Workmaster 35C and 40C compact tractors
item.description: The tractors can be equipped with New Holland's 250LC front loader and 270BC backhoe attachments that are now available.

item.title: Takeuchi-US names Lisitza, Dickerson as regional managers
item.description: Erik Lisitza is the company's new West Region business manager and Lukas Dickerson is the Northeast/Canada Region product manager.

item.title: Massey Services has acquired Solve Pest Pros of Jacksonville, North Carolina
item.description: With this acquisition, Massey Services continues to strengthen its presence in the state, where it will now serve more than 17,000 customers from seven service centers.
